title: Riemannian Optimization on Unknown Manifolds via Stochastic Proximal Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2610.41379v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study Riemannian optimization on an unknown manifold accessed only through feasible samples. The central challenge is to turn feasible samples into optimization steps, i.e., the samples are drawn from the unknown feasible manifold, but do not directly provide the tangent spaces, projections, or retractions required by classic Riemannian methods. Moreover, regions with low objective values may be sparsely represented in the data, so directly sampling from a distribution fitted to these observations can require many draws to find better feasible solutions. We introduce Proximal Refinement on Implicit Smooth Manifolds (PRISM), which turns feasible-sample access into an iterative optimization procedure by repeatedly sampling an objective-aware proximal distribution conditioned on the current iterate. translated_title: 基于随机近端细化的未知流形上的黎曼优化
translated_abstract: 我们研究仅通过可行样本进行访问的未知流形上的黎曼优化问题。核心挑战在于如何将可行样本转化为优化步骤：样本虽然从未知的可行流形中抽取，但并不直接提供经典黎曼方法所需的切空间、投影或回缩映射。此外，目标函数值较低的区域可能在数据中呈现稀疏表示，因此直接从拟合这些观测数据的分布中采样，可能需要大量抽取才能找到更好的可行解。我们提出了隐式光滑流形上的近端细化方法（PRISM），该方法通过反复采样以当前迭代点为条件的、具有目标感知能力的近端分布，将可行样本访问转化为迭代优化过程。在理论方面，我们证明PRISM能够实现与黎曼梯度细化相当的效果，从而带来可证明的目标函数下降和可行性保证。
tldr: 提出PRISM方法，通过对以当前迭代点为条件的目标感知近端分布进行反复采样，仅利用可行样本即可在未知流形上实现具有理论收敛保证的黎曼优化。
en_tdlr: PRISM enables provable Riemannian optimization on unknown manifolds using only feasible samples by repeatedly sampling an objective-aware proximal distribution conditioned on the current iterate.
